# Data Source: catalyst_datastream_channels

List existing Data Streams channels or look up one channel by ID. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.datastreams.channel.READ`. Returns configuration metadata without reading messages, generating subscriber tokens, or publishing data. Verified offline.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_datastream_channels" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
}

output "channel_ids" {
  value = data.catalyst_datastream_channels.existing.channels[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID as a string.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Existing channel's numeric ID. When supplied, the result contains only that channel.

## Attribute Reference

- `channels` (Attributes List) Visible channels sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty successful inventory returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `control_type` (Number) Raw access-control type code, when reported.
- `id` (String) Channel ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `name` (String) Channel name reported by Catalyst.
- `retention_hours` (Number) Stream retention duration in hours, when reported.
